name: Times club monthly special crossword No 20,187

solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Observe male trailing copper's deputy

indicators.note: trailing means following behind, so the piece it describes is placed after the one named next

blocks.note: lo is an old word for look or see
Cu is the chemical symbol for copper
standard abbreviation for male

explanation.surface: A policeman's deputy is being watched as a man follows him about.
explanation.definitionFit: A locum is a stand-in who covers for a doctor or cleric, a deputy in that sense.

clue.text: Article in Libération (French) about short-lived pain for socialist

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so one piece wraps around the other

blocks.note: le is a French definite article, the sort found in a French newspaper
Fr is the abbreviation for French
a twinge is a brief sharp pain

explanation.surface: A reader of the French paper Libération suffers a passing ache over its socialist politics.
explanation.walkthrough: Libération is a left-leaning Paris daily, which makes the political setting apt; the article is the French one, LE.
explanation.definitionFit: A left-winger is a person on the political left, which includes a socialist.

clue.text: Casual as army bosses?

definitions.note: a slangy conjunction rather than an adjective, fair because 'Casual' only labels the register of the word that means 'as'

blocks.note: first meaning: a casual, slangy way of saying 'as' in the sense of because
second meaning: commanding officers, written as an abbreviation with a plural s

explanation.walkthrough: The surface sounds like a comment on relaxed senior officers; the two halves are separate meanings of one short word.
explanation.definitionFit: The slang conjunction stands for because, and COs are commanding officers in military shorthand.

clue.text: When I doubt something it makes … a lot of resistance?

blocks.clueFragment: When I doubt something it makes
blocks.note: surface reading: a person describing their sceptical reaction to something
setter's reading: the ellipsis invites the sceptic's sound of doubt, and run together the phrase spells a large unit of electrical resistance

explanation.surface: Someone explains that doubting something makes them push back hard.
explanation.walkthrough: Complete the sentence as 'it makes me go hm' and close up the spaces: the result is a unit of electrical resistance, not a mood.
explanation.definitionFit: A megohm is a million ohms, so it is a large amount of electrical resistance.

clue.text: Yellow flowering plant in heavy demand bordering the way round narrow street

indicators.note: bordering means lying along both edges, so this piece is split to sit either side of the rest
round means encircling, so one word is wrapped around the other

blocks.note: a tax is a heavy demand on one's money
how means the way something is done
a row is a narrow street of houses

explanation.surface: A yellow-flowered plant is much sought after, growing beside a lane.
explanation.walkthrough: Bordering needs the outer word split unevenly: only its first letter goes in front, and the rest closes the entry. Heavy demand is the taxman's, not a market's.
explanation.definitionFit: Thorow-wax is a yellow-flowered umbelliferous plant whose stem appears to pass through its leaves.

clue.text: Local shoved to the other side, spread across companion

indicators.note: spread across means lying over and around, so one piece encloses the other

blocks.note: thru is an informal spelling of through, to the other side
to ted is to spread out hay for drying
CH is Companion of Honour

explanation.surface: Someone from the area pushed through to the far side, sprawling over a friend.
explanation.walkthrough: Local tells you the definition is a dialect word; CH stands for Companion of Honour, a British order.
explanation.definitionFit: Thrutch is a northern English dialect verb meaning to push or squeeze, so its past tense matches shoved.

clue.text: Carbohydrate ingredients on cereal, mostly yellowish

indicators.note: in a down entry, on means placed above, so this piece comes first
mostly means not quite all, so the last letter is dropped

blocks.note: carbohydrates are made of oxygen, carbon and hydrogen, whose symbols are O, C and H
rye is a cereal grain

explanation.surface: A nutrition label listing what goes into a breakfast cereal that looks a bit yellow.
explanation.walkthrough: The elements of a carbohydrate are carbon, hydrogen and oxygen; their symbols can be taken in any order as ingredients.
explanation.definitionFit: Ochry describes something with the colour of ochre, a yellow-brown earth pigment.

clue.text: Adjust outer tab stop

indicators.note: to adjust is to rearrange or alter, so the following letters are rearranged

blocks.note: the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: An instruction for setting a tab stop on a typewriter or word processor.
explanation.walkthrough: Tab stop looks like one phrase from word processing; stop is the definition, and tab joins outer as the letters to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: To obturate is to close up or block an opening, a formal synonym of stop.

clue.text: Ring-maker almost secures loose jib, tie being something thorny

indicators.note: almost means not quite complete, so the final letter is cut
loose suggests letters set free to fall into a new arrangement
to secure something is to hold it fast, so one piece is held inside another

blocks.note: Wagner composed the Ring cycle of operas
the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A jeweller ties up a loose sail and gets caught on something prickly.
explanation.walkthrough: Ring-maker suggests a jeweller, but it is the composer of the Ring cycle; WAGNE(R) holds the rearranged JIB TIE.
explanation.definitionFit: The wag-'n-bietjie is a South African thorn bush whose name means wait-a-bit, as its hooks snag passers-by.

clue.text: Ten months since … Caruso's birthday?

blocks.note: surface reading: a vague count of time passed since an anniversary
setter's reading: the tenor was born on 25 February, and ten months on lands on 25 December, a festive date written with an X for Christ

explanation.surface: A question about how long it has been since the great tenor's birthday.
explanation.walkthrough: Enrico Caruso was born on 25 February 1873; count ten months on and you reach 25 December.
explanation.definitionFit: Christmas Day falls on 25 December, exactly ten months after the date of Caruso's birth.

clue.text: Weir injured shag in Scottish inlet

indicators.note: injured means damaged or knocked out of shape, so these letters are reshaped
in places the rearranged letters inside the other word

blocks.note: a firth is a Scottish estuary or sea inlet
the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A seabird called a shag gets hurt at a weir in a Scottish estuary.
explanation.walkthrough: Shag reads as the cormorant-like seabird, which suits the inlet, but it is only fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: A fishgarth is an enclosure or dam built across a river for trapping fish, a kind of weir.

clue.text: Sultan's monogram painter put on powerful boat

indicators.note: put on means placed after in an across entry, setting the order of the pieces

blocks.note: a tug is a small, powerful boat that tows ships
RA is a Royal Academician, a painter

explanation.surface: An artist is set aboard a strong boat to paint a sultan's emblem.
explanation.walkthrough: Painter could be a boat's rope, but here it is the usual RA, Royal Academician.
explanation.definitionFit: A tugra is the elaborate calligraphic signature or seal of an Ottoman sultan.

clue.text: Baker possibly into quick and funny food: some Australians eat it

indicators.note: into means going inside, so this name is placed within the other word

blocks.note: witty means quick-minded and amusing
Chet Baker was an American jazz trumpeter; possibly flags him as one example of a Baker
grub is slang for food

explanation.surface: A baker's lively, amusing food goes down well with some Australians.
explanation.walkthrough: Baker wants to be someone who makes bread; it is the jazzman Chet Baker.
explanation.definitionFit: The witchetty grub is a large moth larva eaten as bush tucker by Aboriginal Australians.

clue.text: Reveals parking among golf course's enticements for certain sportspeople

indicators.note: among means in the midst of, so these pieces are set inside another word

blocks.note: Royal Troon is a championship golf course in Ayrshire, Scotland, with a possessive s
to out someone is to reveal their secret
P is the sign for parking

explanation.surface: A golf club displays the perks it uses to lure certain players.
explanation.walkthrough: The sportspeople are anglers, not golfers; the golf course only supplies letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Trout spoons are spinning metal lures that anglers use to tempt trout to bite.

clue.text: In God's embrace, Christian and I mark ideas about class struggle

indicators.note: an embrace holds someone within the arms, so the following pieces sit inside

blocks.note: Mars is the Roman god of war, with a possessive s
Xian is a standard abbreviation for Christian
taken as written
M is the abbreviation for the German mark

explanation.surface: A believer, held in God's arms, notes ideas about the struggle between classes.
explanation.walkthrough: XIAN, the abbreviation for Christian, and I go inside MARS; M for mark follows.
explanation.definitionFit: Marxianism is the body of Marx's theory, which centres on struggle between social classes.

clue.text: Beginner's advantage ebbing?

indicators.note: ebbing describes a tide going back out, so the word runs backwards

blocks.note: a boon is a benefit or advantage

explanation.surface: A wry question whether beginner's luck is wearing off.
explanation.definitionFit: Noob is internet slang for a newcomer or novice, especially in gaming.

clue.text: Soft and hard sports fabric's ordered back for run, producing small blister

indicators.note: back means turned around, so the word for ordered runs the other way
for means in place of, so one thing swaps in where the letter for run stood

blocks.note: p is piano, soft in music
H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils
Lycra is a stretchy fabric used for sportswear
neat means tidy or well ordered
R is the cricket abbreviation for run; this is the letter replaced

explanation.surface: Sports kit made from a stretchy fabric, worn tight, ends up rubbing a blister.
explanation.walkthrough: Ordered means tidy here, not commanded; soft and hard are the musical and pencil abbreviations. The fabric's 's is 'has', not a possessive.
explanation.definitionFit: A phlyctaena is a medical term for a small vesicle or blister on the skin or eye.

clue.text: Year before the writer would scorn the woman who uses vernacular language

definitions.note: a relative clause standing for 'one who', a noun

indicators.note: before means coming earlier, so this piece is placed first in a down entry

blocks.note: Y is the abbreviation for year
the writer is the setter, I, and I would contracts to I'd
to dis is slang for to scorn or disrespect
her refers to a woman

explanation.surface: A year on, the author would look down on a woman who speaks in slang.
explanation.walkthrough: Vernacular here points to the everyday language of Ashkenazi Jews rather than slang in general.
explanation.definitionFit: A Yiddisher is a Jewish person, especially a speaker of Yiddish, the traditional everyday tongue.

clue.text: Contribution from pinch-hitter billed to overturn score-books?

indicators.note: a contribution from something is a part of it, so the letters lie inside the words
to overturn is to turn upside down, so in a down entry the letters read bottom to top

blocks.note: a run of letters across the two words

explanation.surface: A baseball substitute is advertised as the player who can change the score.
explanation.walkthrough: Score sounds sporting after pinch-hitter, but a score is written music and the books are the texts that go with it.
explanation.definitionFit: Libretti are the texts of operas, the word-books that accompany a musical score.

clue.text: Established clear identity encompassing large and small finches

indicators.note: encompassing means surrounding, so one piece sits inside another

blocks.note: est. is the abbreviation for established
to rid is to clear
L is the abbreviation for large
ID is short for identity
S is the abbreviation for small

explanation.surface: Settled and clear identification of birds both large and small.
explanation.walkthrough: Large and small read as sizes of birds, but they are just L and S as on clothing labels.
explanation.definitionFit: Estrildids are the waxbills and their relatives, a family of small Old World finches.

clue.text: Briefly open, like a door by old privy

indicators.note: briefly means cut short, so the last letter is dropped

blocks.note: a door that is ajar is slightly open
x is the multiplication sign, read as by in dimensions such as two by four

explanation.surface: A lavatory door left slightly open for a moment.
explanation.walkthrough: Sir John Harington's pamphlet The Metamorphosis of Ajax punned on 'a jakes', an old word for a privy.
explanation.definitionFit: Ajax was Elizabethan slang for a lavatory, from a pun on jakes, meaning privy.

clue.text: Traditional monarch in Victorian days' latter times upset knight

indicators.note: upset means turned over, so in a down entry the word reads from the bottom up

blocks.note: in the Australian state of Victoria, the latter part of the day is the arvo, Australian slang for afternoon
N is the knight in chess notation

explanation.surface: In the later years of Victoria's reign, a knight was overthrown.
explanation.walkthrough: Victorian looks like the British era, but it means someone from Victoria in Australia, where afternoons are arvos.
explanation.definitionFit: Sovran is an old poetic spelling of sovereign, a ruling king or queen.

clue.text: Sign area on page after paragraph with flowery adornment for later additions

indicators.note: after means following, so the pieces it governs come later in the entry
in an across entry, on means placed after the piece it rests on

blocks.note: para is short for paragraph
a lei is a Hawaiian garland of flowers
p is the abbreviation for page
an omen is a sign of things to come
A is the abbreviation for area

explanation.surface: An editor's instructions for laying out a page with a decorated paragraph.
explanation.definitionFit: Paraleipomena are things omitted from a main work and added afterwards as a supplement.

clue.text: Member meeting first of immigrants in unsettled states

indicators.note: meeting means joining up with, so the two pieces are placed side by side
first of means only the opening letter of the next word is used

blocks.note: a limb is a member of the body
the opening letter

explanation.surface: A politician meets newly arrived immigrants in states with unstable governments.
explanation.walkthrough: Member and states suggest parliament and nations; the states are conditions of uncertainty.
explanation.definitionFit: Limbi is a plural of limbo, a condition of uncertainty or neglect, an unsettled state.

clue.text: Requirement of faith in judges after chap's inside

indicators.note: inside means the interior, so the middle letters of the word are kept
after means following, so the word before it comes second

blocks.note: the middle letters, losing the first and last
J is the abbreviation for judge, doubled for the plural

explanation.surface: A legal requirement about religious belief sits with judges over a man's private views.
explanation.definitionFit: The hajj, the pilgrimage to Mecca, is a duty of Islam, one of its five pillars.

clue.text: Old blue painting maybe extended over Miró's frame

indicators.note: the frame of a word is its border, the first and last letters
extended over means stretched across, so one piece encloses the other

blocks.note: painting is an example of art
the first and last letters

explanation.surface: An old blue painting, perhaps by Miró, stretched across its frame.
explanation.walkthrough: Blue reads as a painter's colour; here it means sad.
explanation.definitionFit: Amort is an obsolete word meaning as if dead, dejected, so it stands for gloomy or downcast.

clue.text: Hindu teacher graduate, strict one accepting instructor's lead

indicators.note: a lead is what comes at the front, so only the opening letter is kept
accepting means taking in, so one piece goes inside another

blocks.note: an MA is a Master of Arts graduate
harsh means severe or strict
the opening letter
Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A graduate guru, a strict one, accepts the lead of his instructor.
explanation.definitionFit: A maharishi is a Hindu sage or spiritual guide, a great seer who teaches.

clue.text: Informal apology from more than half-cut drunk

indicators.note: cutting more than half of a word leaves fewer than half its letters, the front part

blocks.note: sozzled is slang for drunk

explanation.surface: A tipsy person mumbling sorry after a few too many.
explanation.walkthrough: Half-cut is itself slang for drunk, which disguises its job of chopping off over half of the word.
explanation.definitionFit: Soz is British slang for sorry, an offhand apology.

clue.text: Supreme court figure is only more aloof with answer for case's conclusion

indicators.note: the conclusion of a word is its final letter
for means in place of, so one letter swaps in where another stood

blocks.note: just means only
icier means colder, more distant
A is the abbreviation for answer
the final letter, which is replaced

explanation.surface: A top judge is merely more distant when answering at the end of a case.
explanation.walkthrough: In ICIER, the A for answer replaces the E that ends the word case.
explanation.definitionFit: A justiciar was the chief political and judicial officer of the medieval Norman and Angevin kings.

clue.text: Island in southern land given to American Indian son of 20

definitions.note: 20 is the answer at 20-down, a ruler

indicators.note: in places the island's letter inside the abbreviation for the land
given to means added on, so the next piece follows

blocks.note: New Zealand, a southern-hemisphere country, abbreviated
I is the abbreviation for island
Am is short for American

explanation.surface: An island off New Zealand is handed to an American Indian.
explanation.walkthrough: American Indian reads as one phrase, but American belongs to the wordplay and Indian to the definition, which refers to the answer at 20-down.
explanation.definitionFit: The Nizam was the hereditary sovereign of Hyderabad, an Indian ruler in a dynasty passed from father to son.
